title: Inequalities & Absolute Values
description: Working with inequalities, absolute values, case analysis and solution sets.
html:
⚖️ Inequalities & Absolute Values

1. Rules

$$a < b \Rightarrow a + c < b + c; \quad c > 0: ac < bc; \quad c < 0: ac > bc$$

Important

Multiplying or dividing by a negative number flips the sign. Never multiply by a term of unknown sign.

Example

$$3 - 2x \le 7 \iff x \ge -2, \qquad L = [-2, \infty)$$

2. Quadratic inequalities

$$x^2 - x - 6 < 0 \iff (x + 2)(x - 3) < 0 \iff -2 < x < 3$$

Parabola opening upwards: $< 0$ between the roots, $> 0$ outside. Careful: $x^2 > 4 \iff x < -2$ or $x > 2$.

3. Rational inequalities

Either case distinction (denominator $> 0$ or $< 0$) or bring everything to one side and compare the signs of numerator and denominator.

$$\frac{3}{x - 1} \ge 1 \iff \frac{4 - x}{x - 1} \ge 0 \iff x \in (1, 4]$$

4. The absolute value

$$|x| = \begin{cases} x & x \ge 0 \\ -x & x < 0 \end{cases}, \qquad |x - a| = \text{distance between } x \text{ and } a$$

$$|x - a| < r \iff a - r < x < a + r, \qquad |x - a| > r \iff x < a - r \text{ or } x > a + r$$

Rules

$$|ab| = |a||b|, \quad \sqrt{x^2} = |x|, \quad |a + b| \le |a| + |b| \ \text{(triangle inequality)}$$

5. Absolute-value equations

Case distinction at the points where the content of the absolute value changes sign. Check solutions against the case assumption.

$$|x - 1| + |x + 2| \le 5 \iff x \in [-3, 2]$$
